about.title: About
about.subtitle: The story behind the glow.
about.description1: Lumen is an offline-first, open-source music player template — a soft yellow glow against a dark canvas, tuned for iPhone and desktop alike.
about.description2: It ships with zero bundled music. Import your own songs and Lumen reads their title, artist, album, and cover art automatically. Everything — your library, playlists, favorites, and settings — lives only on this device.
about.architectureBody: Vanilla HTML, CSS and JavaScript. No frameworks, no build step, no backend. IndexedDB for storage, the Web Audio API for the visualizer, and a Service Worker for offline use.

diagnostics.title: Local resource diagnostics
diagnostics.manual: Select the text below and copy manually.
diagnostics.hint: Read-only checks. No data is cleared, imported or rewritten; no storage permission is requested. Missing optional instrumental is not main-media damage. Field names in the report are technical identifiers.
diagnostics.caution: Object existence, readable data and loadable metadata are distinct results. Partial reads do not prove integrity or codec support.
diagnostics.metadataCaution: Metadata loading does not play audio or prove full decoding/playback. Failure or timeout alone does not prove the file was cleared.
